pages.text: $(italic)A puppet master who commands from the shadows. Your servants fight, and their violence feeds your power.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -10%  |  Equipment HP: $(bold)Halved$() (glass cannon)$(br)Mana Pool: $(item)1.5x base$() (150 from default 100)$(br)$(bold)Core Identity:$() Empowered minions + lifesteal.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Dark Pact$() — Tamed/summoned entities deal $(item)+15% damage$(). Your army hits harder.$(br2)$(bold)Soul Tether$() — Mob deaths within 16 blocks: $(item)5% lifesteal$() (capped 2 HP) + $(item)10% bonus XP$(). Your servants feed you.$(br2)$(bold)Shadow Cloak$() — +10% damage in darkness. Caves and night are your domain.

pages.title: Summoner Playstyle
pages.text: Pairs best with Occultism summoning (T3) and Iron's Spells summon spells. Your personal combat is weak — your minions are your weapon. Soul Tether keeps you alive.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Revenant$() — +20% in darkness + Shadow Cloak.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$() — +40% HP offsets glass cannon.$(br)$(thing)Faefolk$() — Magic bonuses enhance summons.$(br2)$(bold)Next: learn Summon Vex from your starter scroll — your first servant.$()
